## Change

Describe the problem and resulting user-visible behavior.

## Evidence

Describe the synthetic input or scenario, the checks actually run, and their results. State any checks not run.

## Review

- [ ] No private statement data, credentials, or personal identifiers are included.
- [ ] Statement data still stays local, with no third-party scripts or tracking.
- [ ] Parser or money changes have meaningful synthetic regression tests.
- [ ] New layout assumptions are marked and documented in docs/PARSERS.md.
- [ ] Keyboard access, labels, mobile layout, and chart tables remain usable.
- [ ] Documentation matches the final change.
